topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Can you believe it? My college application essay, the one I poured my heart into, is now an example they show to others! I was just sitting there, scrolling through my feed, and boom—there it was. I’m like, wow, all that time stressing over every word, wondering if it was good enough, and now it’s being used to show how it’s done. It’s like when you plant a seed and you’re not sure if it’ll grow, and then one day, there it is, sprouting and strong. I can’t help but feel like everything I put into it was worth it. And who knows, maybe my words will help someone find their way, just like so many helped me find mine.
